items.source: Simple constructor with reactive type support based on a default instance of ReactiveAdapterRegistry, SyncTaskExecutor, and ContentNegotiationManager with an Accept header strategy.
items.translation: 支持基于默认实例的简单构造函数，该实例包括 ReactiveAdapterRegistry、SyncTaskExecutor 以及带有 Accept 标头策略的 ContentNegotiationManager。

items.source: messageConverters - converters to write emitted objects with
items.translation: messageConverters - 用于写入已发出对象的转换器

items.source: registry - for reactive return value type support
items.translation: registry - 用于支持响应式返回值类型

items.source: executor - for blocking I/O writes of items emitted from reactive types
items.translation: executor - 用于来自反应式类型的项的阻塞 I/O 写入。

items.source: manager - for detecting streaming media types
items.translation: manager - 用于检测流媒体类型

items.source: Single-value reactive types are adapted to DeferredResult. Multi-value reactive types are adapted to ResponseBodyEmitter or SseEmitter as follows:
items.translation: 单值响应式类型适配为 DeferredResult。多值响应式类型则按如下方式适配为 ResponseBodyEmitter 或 SseEmitter：

items.source: Handle the given return value by adding attributes to the model and setting a view or setting the ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean) flag to true to indicate the response has been handled directly.
items.translation: 处理给定的返回值，通过向模型添加属性并设置视图，或设置ModelAndViewContainer.setRequestHandled(boolean)标志为true，以指示响应已被直接处理。

items.source: Whether the given method return type is supported by this handler.
items.translation: 给定方法返回类型是否由该处理器支持。

items.source: Constructor that with added arguments to customize "reactive" type support.
items.translation: 带有附加参数以自定义“反应式”类型支持的构造函数。

items.source: Constructor that with added arguments for view rendering.
items.translation: 带有视图渲染附加参数的构造函数。

items.source: ResponseBodyEmitter including sub-class SseEmitter and others.
items.translation: ResponseBodyEmitter（包括其子类 SseEmitter 等）。

items.source: Text stream for a Publisher of CharSequence.
items.translation: 类型为 Publisher 的文本流，该 Publisher 实现了 CharSequence。

items.source: localeResolver - the LocaleResolver for fragment stream rendering
items.translation: localeResolver - 用于片段流渲染的LocaleResolver

items.source: Reactive return types known to ReactiveAdapterRegistry.
items.translation: 已知于 `ReactiveAdapterRegistry` 的反应式返回类型。

items.source: Any of the above wrapped with ResponseEntity.
items.translation: 上述任何内容均被 `ResponseEntity` 包装。

items.source: SSE stream, if the element type is ServerSentEvent or if negotiated by content type.
items.translation: SSE 流，如果元素类型为 ServerSentEvent 或通过内容类型协商。

items.source: A JSON stream if negotiated by content type to MediaType.APPLICATION_NDJSON.
items.translation: 如果通过内容类型协商为 MediaType.APPLICATION_NDJSON，则为 JSON 流。

items.source: viewResolvers - resolvers for fragment stream rendering
items.translation: viewResolvers - 用于片段流渲染的解析器

items.translation: returnType - 返回值的类型。此类型必须此前已传递给HandlerMethodReturnValueHandler.supportsReturnType(MethodParameter)，且该调用必须返回true。

items.source: true if this handler supports the supplied return type; false otherwise
items.translation: true 如果此处理器支持提供的返回类型；否则为 false。
